correctness.rationale: The stationary density is an exponential-age convex mixture of n-fold coherent product states. Squared coherent overlap is exp[−b(1−cos(ω(t−s)))] with b=4a²/σ², and difference of independent exponential reset ages has bilateral Laplace law, giving the exact purity integral P_n=α∫exp(−αu−bn(1−cos u))du. Positive absolutely convergent Bessel Fourier series yields the stated I_k-weighted expression and strict α-monotonicity. Fixed-rate e^(−z)I_k(z)~(2πz)^(−1/2), summably dominated by I_0, gives the coth coefficient and the entropy combination. For α_N/sqrt(bN)→c finite, V~Exp(1) dominated convergence yields F(c)=c sqrt(π/2)exp(c²/2)erfc(c/sqrt2); Bessel upper bound and cosine inequality give endpoints c=0,∞. Independent numerical Laplace-integral/Bessel checks at twelve positive parameter points and three critical scalings matched. The state is separable over particle labels and the entropy combination is not an entanglement measure.
